entry.title: WealthTrees - Personal Asset Tracking
entry.content:
WealthTrees is a lightweight personal finance app that uses a “tree structure” to manage assets: create groups first, then add specific assets, helping you quickly understand your total assets and allocation ratio. It supports profit/loss tracking, structural breakdown statistics, and optional multi-device sync.

Introduction

WealthTrees helps you understand your asset structure at a glance.

You can use a simple “tree” model to build your personal assets: create groups (such as cash, investments, real estate, etc.) and add asset items under each group. View the total amount, allocation ratio, and performance on one page.

Core Features:

  • Group + asset item management
  • Total assets and allocation ratio breakdown
  • Profit/loss tracking (amount and percentage)
  • Multi-currency support and exchange rates
  • Optional multi-device sync
  • Data export and sharing

The overall design focuses on being lightweight and easy to use: update anytime, see everything clearly right away.

Download WealthTrees and start your personal asset management journey!

entry.title: Monster Chores - Chore Points and Rewards
entry.content:
• Make chores fun: chore lists + points + rewards.
  • Assign chores, review completion, and turn effort into points.
  • A clean family chore and reward tracker with optional iCloud family sync.

Brief Introduction

Monster Chores helps families turn daily chores into a simple “points + rewards” system. Parents create chores and rewards, children complete chores (optionally uploading photos), and parents review them before awarding points. It supports progress statistics and optional iCloud sync to share family data across devices.

What It Can Do (Overview)

  • Create chore tasks: set points and repeat frequency (once/daily/weekly).
  • Children mark tasks as completed, and parents review and confirm point rewards.
  • Track point transactions and redeem rewards in the family “store”.
  • View weekly activity charts and a simple leaderboard.
  • Support multiple children and switching between different roles/accounts.
  • Support JSON import/export for backup and recovery.

Core Features (Store Copy)

  • Parent/Child Roles: Clear assignment and completion of responsibilities.
  • Review System: Pending review list, view details, and approve with one tap to award points.
  • Points and Transaction History: Record the full history of points earned/spent/adjusted.
  • Reward Store: Define rewards, set point costs, and complete redemptions.
  • Statistics and Charts: Weekly activity, points for the current week, and recent completion records.
  • Family Management: Create families, invite members, and switch families.
  • Optional iCloud Sync: Share family data through iCloud/CloudKit (invitation link).
  • Data Migration Supported: JSON export/import (note: photos are not included in JSON).

Value Points

  • More Motivation: Points and rewards make habits easier to maintain.
  • More Fairness: Reviews + history keep rules consistent.
  • More Visibility: Children can see progress, and parents can see trends.
  • Optional Sync: Local use by default; enable iCloud Family Sharing only when needed.

Keywords (Metadata)

chore list, chores, kids chores, allowance, family, rewards, points, habit tracking, parenting, family management

  • App Store: Monster Chores

entry.title: Eve Period Tracker - Elegant Period Tracking App
entry.content:
Eve Period is a period tracking and management app designed for women. Built with native SwiftUI, it provides a clean, private, and reliable cycle tracking experience.

Highlights

  • Cycle calendar + smart predictions
  • Quickly record start/end dates, with notes supported
  • Local reminders and email reminders, with customizable time
  • Private iCloud sync + JSON import/export
  • Chinese/English switching, no ads, no tracking

Why Choose It

  • Native SwiftUI experience, smooth and fast
  • Data is stored in your private iCloud space with end-to-end encryption
  • Free to use: no ads, no subscriptions
  • Clear data statistics: average cycle, shortest/longest cycle, countdown to next period

Quick Start

  1. Tap “Period Start” and “Period End” to complete a record.
  2. Configure reminder time and advance days in Settings.
  3. When you need to back up or switch devices, you can export JSON or import data anytime for migration.

Tech Stack

  • SwiftUI + SwiftData, CloudKit private database
  • UNUserNotificationCenter local reminders, with optional email reminders

Download Eve Period Tracker and start your smart cycle management journey!

entry.title: Pushup Log - Pushup Counting and Statistics
entry.content:
Pushup Log is a lightweight pushup counting and logging tool—permanently 100% free (no subscriptions, no in-app purchases).

During a workout, tap anywhere to count. You can manually end the workout (or let it end automatically after a period of inactivity), and every workout will be saved. It supports reviewing history with charts, syncing across devices using iCloud (optional), and writing pushup counts to Apple Health (optional).

Highlights

  • Tap to count: clean interface, fast logging
  • Automatically save workouts + editable history
  • Daily/weekly/monthly/yearly statistics and charts
  • Local notification reminders (optional)
  • iCloud multi-device sync (optional)
  • Apple Health integration (optional; write-only)
  • Supports JSON data export/import

Why Choose It

  • No account required: no ads, no tracking, no analytics
  • Lightweight and unobtrusive, focused on logging
  • Data is stored locally by default (optional iCloud sync)
  • Permanently 100% free: no subscriptions, no in-app purchases

Quick Start

  1. Open Pushup Log and tap anywhere to start counting.
  2. Manually end the workout (or wait for it to end automatically after inactivity).
  3. View history and charts, and set reminders if needed.
  4. Export/import JSON anytime for backup or data migration.

Tech Stack

  • SwiftUI (iOS)
  • iCloud sync (optional)
  • HealthKit pushup data writing (optional; write-only)

App Store Link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6757068491
